notes: Corrected Filipino Kamalayang Ponolohikal items: paaralan is 4 pantig (pa-a-ra-lan), and puno now uses the clear rhyme tuno; ambiguous rhyme pairs were removed.
Expanded Filipino questions across all seven competencies used in Terms 1, 2 and 3 to reduce repetition.
Added a question-integrity guard across all subjects so the stored correct answer cannot be omitted from the available choices.
Tournament Mode remains exactly 3 choices in one horizontal row with no guide or arrow labels.
Tournament answer buttons now turn solid BLUE on Blue Team turn and solid RED on Red Team turn; correct answers still highlight green.
Larger Tournament question/choice fonts and editable character names from v1.5.16 are preserved.
Bracket intro, replacement Grand Finals video, finalist student photos/images, Reset Stats, rankings, third place and Best-of-3 finals are preserved.
